description: Resolve a BIC / SWIFT code into the underlying bank: name, country, city, LEI, and registered head-office address (where available). USE WHEN: the user already has a BIC/SWIFT (8 or 11 chars, alphanumeric, e.g., "UBSWCHZH80A", "DEUTDEFF") and asks which bank it belongs to, where the bank is, or its LEI for compliance/regulatory matching. DO NOT USE for IBAN inputs — call validate_iban instead, it resolves the BIC for you. BACKED BY: a BIC directory of GLEIF and national registers, refreshed monthly, plus a public copy of the SWIFT directory frozen in January 2018 that still makes up most of the rows; only the GLEIF rows carry an LEI. Live counts: https://api.ibanforge.com/llms.txt. RETURNS: bank_name, country, country_name, city, lei, address (if available). COST: 0.003 USDC.

bic.description: BIC / SWIFT code, 8 or 11 alphanumeric characters. Example: "UBSWCHZH80A" (UBS Switzerland) or "DEUTDEFF" (Deutsche Bank Frankfurt).

name: lookup_bic

outputSchema.description: BIC/SWIFT lookup result from the BIC directory (GLEIF, national registers and a public copy of the SWIFT directory).

address.description: Registered head-office address (GLEIF). null when the BIC carries no LEI or address.

bic.description: Echo of the input, normalized to uppercase.

institution.description: Bank legal name. null when the BIC is not found.

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442); null when none is on file.

title: Lookup BIC/SWIFT
